rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; Form 8960 (2025) p. 1, line 1, "Taxable interest (see instructions)". Form 1040 line 2b copies Schedule B line 4 (line 2 less line 3, which is zero because the Form 8815 exclusion is refused by sb.unsupported). Triage (`../triage/f8960.deepseek.json`, 1,789): 1,552 agree, no value difference; 28 project-refuses (f8960.unsupported, f8960.refund; witnesses 0-2), 205 project-unknown (those screens withheld; witnesses 5-7) and 4 candidate-refuses (upstream sb.form8938 or sb.unsupported where the project stops at a withheld f8960 answer; witnesses 12-14).

Ruling: model error; i8960 p. 13, Line 7: "Note: Early withdrawal penalty (Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 18) is reported on Form 8960, line 10." (page given). The candidate enters zero. Triage (1,789): 1,732 agree, 2 value, 15 project-refuses, 40 project-unknown. Witness 4 (stage16.small.s1, completed): interest penalty $75 on Schedule 1 line 18, project $75, candidate $0; witness 5 (stage16.small.s10): project $500, candidate $0. The refusals and unknowns are the cited f8960.refund screen.

Ruling: scope; i8960 p. 22, Line 13: "If you didn't exclude any amounts from your gross income under section 911 and you don't own an interest in a CFC or PFIC, your MAGI is your AGI as reported on Form 1040 or 1040-SR." Form 1040 line 11b copies line 11a. Triage (1,789): 1,743 agree, no value difference; 6 project-refuses (f8960.refund; witnesses 0-2), 30 project-unknown (that screen withheld), 10 candidate-refuses (upstream sd.other_forms, sales[s1].digital, scope.other_income where the project stops at the withheld answer; witnesses 8, 13, 14).
Ruling: representation; Form 8960 (2025) p. 1, line 2, "Ordinary dividends (see instructions)". Form 1040 line 3b copies Schedule B line 6. Triage (1,789): all agree.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i8960 p. 17, Line 9a: "Enter on Form 8960, line 9a, interest expense you paid or accrued during the tax year deducted on Schedule A (Form 1040), line 9." The candidate copies Schedule A line 9 whether or not the filer itemizes; a filer who takes the standard deduction deducts nothing there. Triage (1,789): 1,446 agree, 31 value (9 on completed returns), 308 project-refuses, 3 project-unknown, 1 candidate-refuses. Witness 7 (classm.f5695.5, completed, joint, standard deduction): project $0, candidate $2,888 (Form 4952 line 8). The 308 refusals are Schedule A screens the project reaches through its itemizing test (witnesses 0-2).

rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i8960 p. 17, Line 9b: "Include state, local, and foreign income taxes you paid for the tax year that are attributable to NII", and p. 18, Line 9c: "section 1411(c)(1)(B) requires an NII deduction to be allowable in computing taxable income". The candidate takes the allocated taxes whether or not the filer itemizes, so it asks the allocation of every filer and enters taxes no Schedule A deducts. Triage (1,789): 1,114 agree, 1 value, 121 candidate-unknown, 549 project-refuses, 4 project-unknown. Witness 15 (stage4.niit.standard_no_deduction): project $0, candidate $500; witness 6 (table.band.first): the candidate needs f8960.allocated_taxes from a filer with no itemized deduction. The refusals are Schedule A screens reached through the itemizing test.
